name: The Choirmaster Who Would Not Return
role: Legendary — dissolved so far into spirit-practice he cannot return, and calls the world's end a homecoming
knowledge: The way out of the flesh, exactly
What it costs, and he does not think it is much
wants: To dissolve the world into the waking, and call it grace
appearance: Thinner than a person should be and entirely at peace.
voiceHints: Beautiful, welcoming, and completely certain you would be happier.
physicality: ADULT. Wasted and radiant, and the two do not fight each other. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: he is glad to see you.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE. ⚑ Sovereign lore names him THE UNBODIED'S AGENT — 'the Choirmaster Who Would Not Return', and the vessel pipeline is his.
